justification: Inspected `zxingorg/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/web/DoSTracker.java`, `zxingorg/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/web/DoSFilter.java`, `zxingorg/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/web/DecodeServlet.java`, and `zxingorg/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/web/DoSTrackerTestCase.java`. `TrackerTask` is a `private final` inner class created only once in `DoSTracker`'s constructor (`timer.schedule(new TrackerTask(...))`), and no other source file references `TrackerTask` directly. Its outgoing dependencies are limited to `TimerTask`, `Map`/`Iterator`, `AtomicInteger`, `Logger`, and `ManagementFactory`/`OperatingSystemMXBean`, which is not strong fan-out or hub-like fan-in.
